findings.claim: The new verdict cache made test_steady_state_runs_no_probes vacuous: its first run (line 556, no WORKTREE_STATUS_NO_CACHE) writes the claude/harvested row to .git/agent-status-cache, so the traced runs at lines 557 and 560 are cache hits that never call evaluate_branch, probe_count stays 0, and no trace line can appear. If the harvested (empty FROM '+' set) branch regressed into probing, the test would still pass. The test was not updated when the cache changed the behaviour it relies on.
findings.evidence: Re-read print_agent_worktrees_status.sh:261-285 at the head: cache_key = tip|raw_from|from_tip|WTS_CANDIDATES_DIGEST|v2; a hit (file present, key equal, 5 lines) reads the five cached lines and skips evaluate_branch; the trace line at 283-285 fires only when probe_count > 0, and probe_count is incremented only inside probe_verdict (verdict.sh:219) reached via evaluate_branch. Between the three runs in test_steady_state_runs_no_probes (test file 556, 557, 560) no ref moves, so tip, FROM tip and the candidate digest (for-each-ref of refs/heads minus claude*) are identical and runs 2 and 3 hit the cache. Contrast test_verdict_cache_hit_and_invalidation (594-595), which asserts exactly this: a warm run emits no trace line regardless of probing. Not in the known ledger.
findings.fix: Run the traced invocations at lines 557 and 560 with WORKTREE_STATUS_NO_CACHE=1 (or clear .git/agent-status-cache before them) so the no-probe assertion exercises evaluate_branch.
